notes.title: Update 1.2 released!
notes.content:
This is the changelog for Version 1.2
[list]
[*]Prayer System added 
[*]5 Prayers added 
[*]Time Counter added
[*]Death Counter added
[/list]
The prayer system allows the player to get temporary buffs for gold. This increases the value of gold (some critics said that there are not enough valuable things you can get for gold). It also rewards the player for exploring the world, because some additional prayers must be found before they can be used.

notes.title: Update 1.1 released!
notes.content:
This is the changelog for Version 1.1
[list]
[*]Added sprinting (press and hold the dodge button to sprint) 
[*]Weapons (especially axes) are looking in the right direction now
[*]When the player enables blocking with the shield, the stamina now regenerates slower. In Version 1.0 the stamina didn't regenerate at all, when the player blocked. 
[*]Toasts: I added toast messages for the tutorial and a warning message if the overweight is too much.
[*]Added different screen resolutions and changed the quality settings a bit.
[/list]
Plans for Version 1.2
[list]
[*]Death and Time Counter
[*]“Prayers” (see below) 
[*]Smoother transitions for levers, doors and chests
[*]Changing the last boss a bit 
[/list]
I have planned a new feature for Davyria Version 1.2, which is called "Prayers". When the player visits a shrine, he can pray and spend money for temporary buffs which are active until the player rests or dies. For example, a typically buff would be:  "+10% damage" or "the next hit doesn't hurt you". Some mightier prayers need to be found in the world until they can be used. 
I wanted to include the prayers already in Version 1.1, but I think it is better to spend more time in this feature.
There are also some other things I want to improve (the ending for example) but this will happen in a later update.

notes.title: Minor Update is coming next week
notes.content:
There will be a Minor Update next Sunday/ Monday. The update will deal with the feedback I got in the review section here as well as some tips i got from the reddit community.  
 
The main aspects are:  
- Enable sprinting 
- Different Display Resolutions  
- Rename Rapier 
- Change the direction axes look  
- Change Tutorial Popup  
 
This is just a minor update (and not the last one). I'm always glad to get feedback from you and to improve the game.
